articles.title_en: The price impact of Canadian retaliatory tariffs
articles.title_cn: 加拿大报复性关税的价格影响
articles.abstract_en: How do import tariffs affect retail prices? We combine daily product-level posted prices from seven major Canadian retailers with product-level tariff exposure to estimate tariff effects in a difference-in-differences framework. Prices of tariffed goods rose gradually, peaking at 6% after three months, implying pass-through of roughly one quarter of the 25% tariff. We find little spillover to untariffed substitutes and a rapid reversal of price effects after tariff removal. Adjustment occurred mainly through the frequency of price changes. Pass-through shifted with trade-policy news and was larger for products labeled “Tariffed”, showing that tariff-induced inflation depends on policy expectations and tariff salience.
articles.abstract_cn: 进口关税如何影响零售价格？我们将来自七家加拿大主要零售商的每日产品层面标价与产品层面关税暴露相结合，在双重差分框架中估计关税效应。被征税商品的价格逐步上升，在三个月后达到峰值6%，意味着对25%关税的传导约为四分之一。我们发现对未被征税替代品的溢出效应很小，且在关税取消后价格效应迅速逆转。调整主要通过价格变动频率实现。传导随贸易政策新闻而变化，对于标注为“Tariffed”的产品更大，表明关税引致的通胀取决于政策预期和关税显著性。

articles.title_en: The future in today’s prices: Evidence from a survey of U.S. firms
articles.title_cn: 当今价格中的未来：来自美国企业调查的证据
articles.abstract_en: Do firms adjust prices to realized costs, expected costs, or both? We address this question using a new survey of U.S. businesses that separately measures realized cost changes since the last price adjustment and expected cost changes over the subsequent year, including portions attributable to 2025 trade policies. Using perceived tariff exposure as an instrument, we identify the causal effects of realized and expected costs on prices. Reset prices incorporate almost 70 percent of current costs and nearly 45 percent of expected costs over the next year. The importance of these channels varies significantly across firms. Frequent price adjusters respond mainly to current costs, while sticky-price firms weight expectations more heavily. Goods producers adjust contemporaneously, whereas service firms are more forward looking, as are firms with a high labor share or facing high trade uncertainty. This evidence favors endogenous pricing frameworks in which uncertainty reshapes the reset-price kernel across horizons or imperfect-information models in which uncertainty amplifies the role of expectations over standard time-dependent models.
articles.abstract_cn: 企业是根据已实现成本、预期成本还是两者来调整价格？我们利用一项新的美国企业调查来回答这个问题，该调查分别衡量了自上次价格调整以来的已实现成本变化和随后一年的预期成本变化，包括可归因于2025贸易政策的部分。以感知到的关税暴露作为工具变量，我们识别了已实现成本和预期成本对价格的因果效应。重新设定的价格纳入了几乎70%的当前成本和近45%的未来一年预期成本。这些渠道的重要性在企业间差异显著。频繁调整价格的企业主要对当前成本作出反应，而粘性价格企业则更重视预期。商品生产商同期调整，而服务企业更具前瞻性，劳动份额高或面临高贸易不确定性的企业也是如此。这一证据支持内生定价框架，即不确定性重塑跨期限的重新定价核，或支持不完全信息模型，即不确定性放大了预期相对于标准时间依赖模型的作用。

articles.title_en: Inflation, households, and central banks around the world
articles.title_cn: 通货膨胀、家庭与世界各国央行
articles.abstract_en: Which facts about households’ inflation expectations are universal across countries and demographic groups? Using homogeneous survey data from 32,000 respondents in 32 countries. We find substantial heterogeneity in inflation perceptions and expectations: older, male, and economically literate respondents report lower values, while unemployed and impatient respondents higher values. Yet, we detect striking similarity in how perceptions translate into expectations across demographic groups and countries. Inflation narratives also differ sharply: Europeans emphasize geopolitical shocks and supply disruptions, whereas respondents in high-inflation countries blame central banks. Support for non-standard central-bank mandates also varies systematically. Respondents whose preferred mandates differ from those they perceive central banks to pursue have higher inflation expectations and lower trust.
articles.abstract_cn: 关于家庭通胀预期的哪些事实在各国和各人口群体中具有普遍性？我们使用来自32个国家32,000名受访者的同质调查数据。我们发现通胀感知和预期存在显著异质性：年龄较大、男性以及经济素养较高的受访者报告较低数值，而失业和缺乏耐心的受访者报告较高数值。然而，我们发现感知转化为预期的方式在各人口群体和国家之间具有惊人的相似性。通胀叙事也差异显著：欧洲人强调地缘政治冲击和供给中断，而高通胀国家的受访者则归咎于央行。对非常规央行职责的支持也系统性变化。偏好职责与其所感知央行追求职责不同的受访者，具有更高的通胀预期和更低的信任。

articles.abstract_en: Empirical evidence commonly cited as indicating that inflation expectations have become better anchored includes the declining sensitivity of expectations to inflation surprises over time, particularly around the adoption of inflation targeting. These patterns are typically attributed to the influence of explicit or implicit inflation targets on inflation expectations. We show that this evidence is consistent with a model of experience-based learning in which individuals learn solely from their life-time history of realized inflation, without anchoring their expectations to an announced inflation target. In this model, the prolonged experience of low short-run inflation persistence in the pre-COVID decades renders long-run expectations insensitive to inflation surprises, matching the patterns observed in empirical anchoring tests. A unique prediction of the experience-based learning model is also borne out in the data: the decline in surprise sensitivity since the 1980s is strongest among younger individuals. The memory of low inflation persistence experiences further explains why long-run inflation expectations remained stable in the face of the post-COVID inflation surge. At the same time, simulations indicate that the sensitivity of long-run expectations to inflation surprises would rise sharply if individuals were to experience another sustained episode of highly persistent inflation. Overall, long-run inflation expectations may be less firmly anchored than commonly believed.
articles.abstract_cn: 通常被引用来表明通胀预期已更好地锚定的经验证据包括：预期对通胀意外的敏感性随时间下降，尤其是在采用通胀目标制前后。这些模式通常被归因于明确或隐含的通胀目标对通胀预期的影响。我们表明，这些证据与一个基于经验的学习模型相一致，在该模型中，个体仅从其一生所经历的实际通胀历史中学习，而不将其预期锚定于已宣布的通胀目标。在该模型中，COVID前数十年长期经历的低短期通胀持续性使得长期预期对通胀意外不敏感，与经验锚定检验中观察到的模式相符。基于经验的学习模型的一个独特预测也在数据中得到证实：自1980以来，意外敏感性的下降在较年轻个体中最为明显。对低通胀持续性经历的记忆进一步解释了为何长期通胀预期在COVID后通胀飙升面前保持稳定。同时，模拟表明，如果个体再次经历一段持续的高持续性通胀，长期预期对通胀意外的敏感性将急剧上升。总体而言，长期通胀预期可能没有人们通常认为的那样牢固锚定。

articles.title_en: Early results from the RESET demonstration project: Inflation in food at home
articles.title_cn: RESET示范项目的早期结果：家庭食品通胀
articles.abstract_en: This paper presents early results from the RESET Demonstration Project, an initiative that constructs price and sales indices using item-level transactions data. The project’s overarching goal is to demonstrate the feasibility and advantages of leveraging modern transactions data for economic measurement by pointing toward a future in which official economic statistics are rebuilt on 21st-century data and technology. The paper introduces new inflation measures for Food at Home and evaluates them on two fronts: how they compare to current official statistics and what they offer as novel measures that capture more accurately the dynamics of consumer choice. The paper also addresses the challenges of producing reliable and credible official statistics from item-level transactions data and reports findings on recent Food at Home inflation trends.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文介绍了RESET示范项目的早期结果，该项目是一项利用单品层面交易数据构建价格和销售指数的倡议。该项目的总体目标是通过指向一个以21世纪的数据和技术重建官方经济统计的未来，来展示利用现代交易数据进行经济测量的可行性和优势。本文介绍了家庭食品的新通胀指标，并从两个方面对其进行评估：它们与当前官方统计的比较情况，以及它们作为更准确捕捉消费者选择动态的新指标所提供的价值。本文还讨论了从单品层面交易数据生成可靠且可信的官方统计所面临的挑战，并报告了近期家庭食品通胀趋势的发现。

articles.abstract_en: This paper revisits the question of what core inflation is meant to represent and assesses the competing measures of core inflation that are available, including some new ones. I take the primary perspective that core inflation is a simple predictor of future headline inflation. There is evidence for ex food and energy, and other core measures, being superior predictors than headline inflation itself. Within choices of core inflation, simple averaging of different measures and different horizons seems to work best. I also consider some other concepts of core inflation: closeness to a common trend component and measurement of demand-driven inflation. The averaging estimator fares well by all of these metrics.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文重新审视核心通胀旨在代表什么这一问题，并评估现有的相互竞争的核心通胀度量指标，包括一些新的指标。我主要从核心通胀是未来总体通胀的简单预测指标这一视角出发。有证据表明，剔除食品和能源的指标以及其他核心指标比总体通胀本身是更优的预测指标。在核心通胀的各种选择中，对不同指标和不同期限进行简单平均似乎效果最佳。我还考虑了核心通胀的其他一些概念：与共同趋势成分的接近程度以及对需求驱动型通胀的度量。平均估计量在所有这些指标上表现良好。

articles.title_en: Do voters punish inflation or pay cuts? Inflation and real wages in U.S. elections
articles.title_cn: 选民惩罚通胀还是降薪？美国选举中的通胀与实际工资
articles.abstract_en: Between 2021 and 2024, the United States experienced one of the most severe inflation episodes in decades, coinciding with renewed debate over the role of economic conditions for electoral outcomes. This paper studies the political economy of inflation and real wages using U.S. county-level data on family budget costs, nominal income, and electoral results for President and Congress during this period. Exploiting within-state, cross-county variation in changes in local prices over time, it examines how inflation, real wage growth, and purchasing power relate to changes in vote shares of incumbents, vote margins, and turnout. Real wage decline, rather than higher inflation itself, is predictive of Republican electoral gains, in line with an economic voting rationale. Inflation, however, retains an association with presidential vote shares beyond pure economic voting.
articles.abstract_cn: 在2021至2024期间，美国经历了数十年来最严重的通胀时期之一，与此同时，经济状况对选举结果作用的讨论再度兴起。本文利用该时期美国县级家庭预算成本、名义收入和总统与国会选举结果数据，研究通胀与实际工资的政治经济学。利用州内跨县的地方价格随时间变化差异，本文考察通胀、实际工资增长和购买力如何与现任者得票率变化、得票差距和投票率相关。实际工资下降，而非通胀本身上升，能够预测共和党选举收益，这与经济投票逻辑一致。然而，通胀在纯粹经济投票之外仍与总统得票率存在关联。

articles.title_en: Decomposing shifts in the Beveridge curve: Implications for labor market dynamics and inflation
articles.title_cn: 分解贝弗里奇曲线的变动：对劳动力市场动态和通胀的含义
articles.abstract_en: This paper explores the relationship between standard labor market tightness (vacancies divided by unemployment) and generalized labor market tightness (vacancies divided by a measure of effective searchers that accounts for potential hires from all sources including those out of the labor force or currently employed). We show that much of the variation in standard tightness that the standard model attributes to variation in matching efficiency reflects changes in the ratio of effective searchers to unemployment rather than changes in “true” matching efficiency. Generalized tightness outperforms standard tightness in Phillips curve equations, both in models with tightness entering linearly and in better-fitting models with tightness entering nonlinearly. In models that distinguish between movements in generalized tightness due to movements along the generalized Beveridge curve versus Beveridge curve shifts (reflecting changes in generalized matching efficiency and other factors), changes in tightness due to Beveridge curve shifts explain more of the variation in inflation.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文探讨标准劳动力市场紧张度（空缺除以失业）与广义劳动力市场紧张度（空缺除以一种有效求职者度量，该度量考虑了来自所有来源的潜在雇佣，包括那些退出劳动力队伍或当前已就业的人）之间的关系。我们表明，标准模型归因于匹配效率变化的标准紧张度变动中的很大一部分，反映的是有效求职者与失业之比的变化，而非“真实”匹配效率的变化。广义紧张度在菲利普斯曲线方程中优于标准紧张度，无论是在紧张度线性进入的模型中，还是在拟合更好的紧张度非线性进入的模型中。在区分广义紧张度因沿广义贝弗里奇曲线移动而产生的变动与贝弗里奇曲线移动（反映广义匹配效率及其他因素的变化）的模型中，由贝弗里奇曲线移动引起的紧张度变化解释了更多通胀变动。

articles.title_en: Beyond costs: The dominant role of strategic complementarities in pricing
articles.title_cn: 超越成本：战略互补性在定价中的主导作用
articles.abstract_en: This paper documents five empirical facts about the role of strategic complementarities in firms’ price-setting behavior, using administrative data on Chilean firms. (1) Strategic complementarities play a dominant role in price setting, exerting a stronger influence than changes in marginal costs. (2) While the strength of strategic complementarities varies across sectors, it consistently outweighs the role of cost changes. (3) In high-inflation environments, firms become more responsive to changes in their competitors’ prices. (4) Firms respond more strongly to competitors’ price increases than to price decreases, mirroring the ‘rockets and feathers’ phenomenon of costs. (5) Strategic complementarities are stronger among firms with fewer competitors, larger market shares, and broader customer bases. These findings suggest that strategic complementarities — a source of real rigidities — are quantitatively important, state-dependent, asymmetric, and shaped by market structure.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文利用智利企业的行政数据，记录了关于战略互补性在企业定价行为中作用的五个经验事实。(1) 战略互补性在定价中发挥主导作用，其影响强于边际成本的变化。(2) 尽管战略互补性的强度因行业而异，但它始终超过成本变化的作用。(3) 在高通胀环境中，企业对竞争对手价格的变化更为敏感。(4) 企业对竞争对手提价的反应强于对降价的反应，这与成本的“火箭与羽毛”现象相呼应。(5) 在竞争对手较少、市场份额较大、客户基础较广的企业中，战略互补性更强。这些发现表明，战略互补性——实际刚性的一个来源——在数量上具有重要意义、具有状态依赖性、不对称性，并受市场结构塑造。

articles.title_en: Inflation and price dispersion: New cross-sectoral and international evidence
articles.title_cn: 通货膨胀与价格分散：新的跨部门和国际证据
articles.abstract_en: Product-level web-scraped data from over 60,000 restaurants and supermarkets across 18 countries, spanning annualized inflation rates from zero to 20 percent, reveal a robust positive comovement between inflation and price dispersion. Suboptimal inflation distorts product-level relative prices in all inflation environments and heterogeneously across sectors. As inflation rises from zero to 10 percent, inefficient price dispersion is 46 percent higher for supermarkets and 73 percent higher for restaurants. The relationship does not flatten at higher inflation, so the marginal cost of inflation does not vanish—a pattern standard menu-cost models do not generate. Accommodating higher inflation therefore entails substantial welfare costs.
articles.abstract_cn: 来自18个国家超过60,000家餐厅和超市的产品层面网络抓取数据，涵盖从零到20%的年化通胀率，揭示了通货膨胀与价格分散之间稳健的正向联动。次优通货膨胀在所有通胀环境中扭曲产品层面的相对价格，且在不同部门间存在异质性。当通胀率从零升至10%时，超市的低效价格分散高出46%，餐厅高出73%。该关系在更高通胀水平下并未趋平，因此通货膨胀的边际成本并未消失——标准菜单成本模型无法生成这一模式。因此，容忍更高的通货膨胀会带来巨大的福利成本。
